overall_goal: Serve the couscous, vegetables, and fish cakes into bowls and set out cutlery

goals.rationale: The person prepares the serving bowls and transfers the couscous from the pan into them using a spatula.
The person uses a spaghetti spoon and spatula to transfer the cooked vegetables from the pan into the serving bowls, then places the empty pan in the sink.

goals.description: Serve fish cakes onto the bowls
goals.rationale: The person brings the baking tray over and transfers the fish cakes onto the prepared bowls.
The person arranges the plates and places a knife and fork on each to complete the serving setup.
